body.name: \ell_Q
body.def: \(\ell_Q(y;w)\) is the density of the interventional path law obtained by fixing \(W=w\), evaluating the potential outcomes along \(w\), and integrating the prior latents. It is not the observational conditional density of \(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}\mid W=w\).
body.role: Structural outcome-likelihood factor in the adaptive joint-law factorization.
